title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Unified Analysis of BAO, SN Ia, and RSD
description: Unified empirical test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) against BAO, SN Ia, and RSD. The effective gravitational coupling μ(a)=Geff/G is derived from the EFC field equation via an entropy field S(a), with background fixed to ΛCDM (γ=0). With one free amplitude (β=0.16) and fixed transition hyperparameters, EFC reproduces BAO/SN and yields a mildly worse but statistically compatible RSD fit (Δχ²≈+1.7), showing no geometry–growth tension in this first-pass regime-consistency check.

EFC Field Equation.description: Modification to Einstein’s equations where an energy-flow sector contributes to curvature alongside matter and an effective cosmological term.

Energy-flow Stress-Energy.description: Stress-energy of the energy-flow potential E_f, parameterized by coupling \alpha, sourcing metric perturbations and effective gravity.

Effective Gravitational Coupling.description: Derived modification to the Poisson equation for linear perturbations; growth responds to an entropy-governed enhancement of gravity.

Entropy Field Evolution.description: Sigmoid evolution of the normalized entropy field from early-time equilibrium (S\approx0) to late-time saturation (S\to S_\infty), with transition scale a_t and width \sigma.

Linear Growth Equation.description: Linear growth of matter perturbations in log-scale factor derivatives; \mu(a) enhances or suppresses growth relative to GR/\LambdaCDM.

key_results.main_finding: With γ=0 and a derived μ(a)=1+βS(a), EFC matches BAO and SN Ia as in ΛCDM and yields a mildly worse but statistically compatible RSD fit, indicating no geometry–growth tension.
datasets_used: SN Ia: Pantheon+ (16 binned distance-modulus points, z = 0.01–1.0, M marginalized)
RSD: fσ8 from BOSS DR12, eBOSS DR16, DESI Y1 (11 points, z = 0.30–1.52)

sealed_predictions.statement: For fixed transition hyperparameters a_t=0.55 and σ=0.10 with S_∞=1, μ(a)=1+βS(a) rises monotonically from ≈1 at z≳2 to ≈1+β at z≈0; with β≈0.16 this implies a late-time Geff enhancement of ~16% and a specific fσ8(z) curve that exceeds ΛCDM at 0≲z≲1.5.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Future high-precision RSD (e.g., final DESI) and cosmic shear tomography (e.g., LSST/Euclid) measuring fσ8(z) and the growth index; rejection occurs if the best-fit β under fixed {a_t,σ} fails goodness-of-fit at ≥3σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: With γ=0, the background expansion (H(z), distances) is identical to ΛCDM for any β; hence BAO DM/rd and SN Ia distance moduli must remain statistically indistinguishable from ΛCDM.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: BAO+SN analyses detecting non-ΛCDM background evolution at ≥5σ when growth-only EFC (γ=0) is assumed.

kill_criteria: KC1: Combined BAO+SN+RSD likelihoods with full covariances show that the 1-parameter EFC growth-only model (β free; a_t=0.55, σ=0.10 fixed; γ=0) is disfavored relative to ΛCDM at Δχ² ≥ 9 (≈3σ) for comparable degrees of freedom.

KC2: High-precision RSD in 0.5 < z < 1.5 (e.g., final DESI) exclude the EFC μ(a) shape with fixed {a_t, σ} by finding that no value of β yields an acceptable fit (χ²_min − χ²_LCDM ≥ 9, or p-value < 0.003) to fσ8(z).

KC3: Joint weak-lensing + galaxy-clustering (e.g., LSST/Euclid) constrain the late-time enhancement to |μ(z<1)−1| < 0.05 (95% CL), excluding the ≥10% enhancement implied by β ≈ 0.16 at ≥3σ under fixed {a_t, σ}.
KC4: Early-time probes (Planck primary+CMB lensing, high-z growth) detect μ(a) ≠ 1 at z ≳ 2 at ≥3σ (e.g., |μ−1| > 0.02), violating the EFC requirement S(a→0) → 0 and hence μ→1.

KC5: Regime-consistency failure: growth-inferred transition redshift z_t from RSD/weak lensing is inconsistent with the fixed a_t=0.55 (z_t≈0.82) by |Δz_t| ≥ 0.2 at ≥3σ when adopting the EFC sigmoid S(a) form.

related_packages.role: theory baseline and prior EFC derivations

abstract_short: First regime-consistency check: EFC with derived μ(a) achieves Δχ²=+1.7 vs ΛCDM across BAO, SN, RSD.

results.verdict: Compatible within statistical fluctuations, no internal tension

key_findings: μ(a) derived from EFC field equations, not phenomenologically fitted
BAO and SN identical to ΛCDM by construction (γ=0)
RSD slightly worse (Δχ²=+1.7) but within fluctuations
Same S(a) describes geometry and growth without tension
